reference_use: Visually inspected the official SFML logo and Node.js faceted hexagon before generation. GenerateImage did not expose an image-attachment parameter, so reference geometry was described in the prompt. No official-reference pixels or SVG paths were composited into the deliverables.
prompt: Brand logo source for the sfml.js JavaScript binding of SFML, to be cropped for a real website navigation logo and favicon. Crisp flat digital brand artwork, white background, centered emblem above the exact lowercase wordmark "sfml.js". The emblem combines the OFFICIAL Node.js green faceted HEXAGON with the OFFICIAL SFML lime green upright PENTAGON inside it. The outer hexagon is six-sided, with a vertex at the top and a vertex at the bottom, divided into three broad diagonal planes of medium Node green. The inner lime-green pentagon is five-sided, a single point at the TOP, broad shoulders, and a straight FLAT HORIZONTAL BOTTOM, exactly like the SFML logo. It is centered inside the green hexagon with green space around every side. Inside this lime pentagon is the distinctive white SFML symbol: a thick angular white U-shaped inset border with a wide horizontal base and sloping side arms, its two upper tips angling inward toward the roof; between these upper arms is a separate short narrow white triangular wedge hanging downward from the top apex. The lime-green pentagon silhouette itself has its apex UP and its bottom FLAT. White U border plus small white downward wedge at top, lime center. Broad simple crisp geometric strokes, high legibility at favicon size. Style: multimedia-library precision with Node crystalline planes and SFML angular white inlay. Leaf green, lime green, mid forest green, pure white. Below the emblem, text "sfml.js" is complete and clearly legible, thick slightly angular lowercase lettering with a clear period, lime-green sfml and medium Node-green .js. Both the emblem and wordmark are original generated digital logo artwork of the same crisp finish. One centered emblem and one wordmark, generous clean white margin on all four sides, every letter and every shape fully inside the frame.

processing.background_removal: Flood the four-connected exterior from (0, 0), permitting pixels where min(R,G,B) >= 110 and max(R,G,B) - min(R,G,B) <= 130. Only the exterior component becomes transparent; enclosed white symbol pixels stay opaque. This includes the white matte fringe from the generated JPEG.
processing.crop_coordinates: Left, top, right, bottom; right and bottom exclusive.
processing.resampling: Lanczos; proportional scaling with integer rounding

dark_variant.method: Preserve generated geometry and alpha. In the wordmark region x >= 283, scale RGB proportionally where weighted RGB luminance is below 145, raising it to 145 for dark-background legibility.

processing.drawing: None. Both the symbol and lettering are model-generated raster pixels; no hand-drawn or SVG replacement.

validation: Decoded both output PNGs and verified RGBA mode, dimensions, transparent canvas borders, and nonempty opaque content.
Verified the generated white triangle and lower white inset remain opaque.
Inspected both outputs composited on white and charcoal backgrounds, including navigation-size logos and 16/32/48/64-pixel mark previews.
quality_limitations: The selected image is a synthesized SFML/Node-inspired identity, not an exact reproduction of either official mark.

The model retained a lower point on the lime inner silhouette instead of the requested flat-bottom pentagon. The white inset has a flat base and upper-pointing framing, but its triangular notch is simplified.
The original dark-green .js lettering has less contrast on dark backgrounds. A brighter color-adjusted raster variant was created for dark mode; the current website and README use SVG wordmarks.
Stopped after two generation calls as requested; the geometry was not manually redrawn.
